criteria.evidence: "This feature finds each domain the product sits in and writes a full page for it." "Out: one full page for each domain, with its intent, business goal, guiding rules, the kinds of capability it covers in plain words, its scope and its sources." "Given a person who cancels at the checkpoint, when the run ends, then the model returns to how it was." "Writing or placing capabilities and features. Specify capabilities (fn-specify-capabilities) does this."

"The model needs domains because they group its capabilities into fields the industry knows, at the level a business leader talks about." "The reason: a domain is a field the industry names, and sample data is only an example of what the product handles." "The run never sets it firm, because the capabilities' real needs are not known yet."

"Given a domain page with no Sources section, when the grounding check runs, then it fails." "Given a model that needs nothing new, when the run goes again, then every model file stays byte for byte the same." "A domain that holds no main section is not written."

"Out: one full page for each domain, with its intent, business goal, guiding rules, the kinds of capability it covers in plain words, its scope and its sources." "A page that exists is grown. A light page is raised to a full one and keeps what it said." "Given an intent whose page is gone, when the run goes, then it completes and records a warning for that page."

"This feature finds each domain the product sits in and writes a full page for it." "The model needs domains because they group its capabilities into fields the industry knows, at the level a business leader talks about." "Writing business intents. Specify intents (fn-specify-intents) does this."
